title: Cloud Security: request channels
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for request channels.

## Basis

Supported request channels: Supported customer request channels; string list.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Supported request channels |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | portal, API, support |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | portal, API, support |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | portal, API, support |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | portal, API, support |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | portal, API, support |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | portal, API, support |

## Tier comparison

The listed request channels bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
